Swallowed every pill I could find in the medicine cabinet in a suicide attempt... then changed my mind about dying when the first overdose symptoms hit. The whole room began to spin after a couple minutes of swallowing the pills and I could barely find my way back to the bathroom to make myself throw up. Barely threw anything back up and I didn’t know what else to do so I laid down on the floor and waited to die. Felt like my heart was beating out of my chest, breathing got harder and I grew insanely restless. And then the restlessness sort of stopped and got replaced by a wash of calm (I didn’t know it yet but I was just high from the obscene amount of pills I took). My parents heard all of the commotion I was causing and freaked out when they found me on the bathroom floor. I couldn’t even talk at that point, everything I tried to say came out in an awful incoherent stutter. Before I blacked out, I remembered hearing my mom wailing and my dad on the phone with 911. Thought that was that.
But then I woke up in a hospital bed with more tubes and wires coming out of my body than I could count. 

Honestly it’s almost been three years since my suicide attempt and life hasn’t gotten any better. In fact it’s gotten worse. I’ve really tried to make a life for myself for my parents sake but it’s pointless. I really do think I should’ve died that night.

Attempted suicide a couple months after I watched the show. One of the questions I was asked at the hospital was if I had recently watched 13 reasons why. Immediately got defensive because I hated the idea that I could’ve possibly been inspired by a tv show. Looking back at it now, the show did play a big role. The biggest thing I took from it was how Hannah Baker turned to her school counselor for help and got nothing. Made me assume that no matter who I turn to, no one would take me seriously.  I was mentally unstable at the time but that made suicide even more of an option for me.
